LEDE: FriendSlop closed higher on ward integrity and a new afternoon paper.

=== Combat ===
Shared Health pools now back players and monsters. Wards hold forty hit points, regenerate after a one-second pause, and double the next regen delay when shattered.

=== Publishing Desk ===
The Wand Street Journal posts a daily closing when pull requests land and Special Editions when releases publish.
